title:
A mixin type for Genai configs that have fields which serve as references to other 'child' config types/instances.
While the hierarchical config data model does allow for re-use of child configs and a separation of logical concerns,
it makes setting/retrieving the complete configuration more complex. This mixin type provides utility methods to
simplify the process of setting/retrieving child configs.
name: Genai.ParentConfig
